'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Thomas Schumann LS Let The Wookiee Win''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Schumann]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: sheet name "Thomas Schuman"; no objective listed - line 1 is Let The Wookiee Win (V)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' Let The Wookiee Win (V) ''(unconfirmed)''
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
